lines: Devinjit Singh may sell up to ₹0.91 crore of shares in the offer for sale, if all offered shares are sold.
Their shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, which makes this a timely window to discuss liquidity options.
Timing: proceeds have already arrived in hand since 11 Mar 2026, and about ₹2.13 crore is retained as an estimate.
Note the name was verified in the seller table, but holdings appear in one section only, so confirm before the call.
